comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Chopdly (9-knob). Delay that cuts the last cycle into chops (equal, or at note attacks) and plays them back rearranged, reversed and pitched; the result feeds back and gets re-chopped. Chops, Order, Pitch, Reverse and Stretch are named-step knobs (labels: build/selector_metadata.py); the rest are 0..100.
fxid_comment: 0x03B3. Free in every collection in repeat98's FXID registry (checked 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-09; 946 is TapeEcho4). Reserved in this README; add to the registry's themanro release row.

params.name: Time
params.comment: params[5]. Cycle/delay length 30 ms .. 2.5 s, squared curve (45 = ~0.53 s).

params.name: Chops
params.comment: params[6]. Named steps: 0 = Trans (cut at note attacks; none found: 4 equal), 1..16 = equal chops.

params.name: Order
params.comment: params[7]. Named steps: Fwd, Back (chops in reverse order), Swap (pairs swapped), Skip (evens then odds), Stutr (each other chop twice), Build (0, 01, 012...), Mix1-8 (fixed shuffles, every chop once), Rpt1-6 (fixed, chops may repeat or drop), Rand (new shuffle every cycle), Chaos (new random with repeats every cycle).

params.name: Pitch
params.comment: params[8]. Named steps: -12/-7/-5/Unity/+5/+7/+12 = all chops; Oct+ / Oct- = half the chops up / down an octave; Octs = a third up, a third down; Fifth = a third +7, a third -5; Some = half the chops jump +-5/7/12; Wild = every chop jumps. Fixed per-slot coins, so it recalls. Varispeed unless Stretch is on.

params.name: Reverse
params.comment: params[9]. Named steps: Off, Few (1/4 of chops), Alt (every other chop), Half, Most (3/4), All, Ping (chops alternate L/R, forward), Scatr (each chop a fixed pan, forward). Fixed per-slot coins.

params.name: Stretch
params.comment: params[10]. Named steps: 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 3/4 = slower, Off = plain read, 1.5x, 2x = faster; how fast each chop runs through its audio with pitch kept (two-grain crossfade, 46 ms grains). Pitch still applies on top.

params.name: Glide
params.comment: params[11]. Chop edges: 0 = cut where chopped (32-sample anti-click fade); higher = longer fades and the ending chop overlaps the next one (crossfade). 100 = half the shorter chop.

params.name: Feedbk
params.comment: params[12]. Chopped output back into the recording (0 .. 0.95), limited.
